title: 第9章 溪畔见伤痕 携手破境界第10章 暗夜战幽猫 挽弓救情郎
lines: 一夜休整，深夜的白沙滩只剩海浪轻拍声响，火堆燃成暗红余烬，李紫云静静靠在罗止正肩头小憩，两人身影被火光映得格外安静。天边刚泛起鱼肚白，微凉海风便拂过沙滩，天渐渐亮了。
罗止正轻轻起身，动作放得极轻，生怕惊扰身旁之人，借着晨曦微光，坐在一旁处理昨日斩杀的赤须磷虾残骸。他手持骨刀，细细打磨着坚硬赤红的虾螯，神情专注而认真。
李紫云缓缓睁开眼，一眼便望见他忙碌的身影，心头泛起好奇，轻手轻脚走了过去。
李紫云眨着清澈的眼睛，语气带着几分好奇：“止正，你在做什么？”
罗止正抬头看她，眼中漾开温和笑意，扬了扬手中半成品：“帮你做一把灵匕，方便你随身防身。昨日战斗箭支已经用完了，我再用虾壳给你补十支箭。”
说话间，他已将虾螯削成小巧锋锐的匕身，用柔韧藤条仔细缠好握柄，一柄寒气内敛的赤螯灵匕便算成型。余下的虾壳则被削成箭头，配上木杆与羽翎，不多时，十支赤壳灵箭整整齐齐摆放在石块上，威力远超寻常木箭。
李紫云看着眼前精致的灵匕与箭矢，心头一暖，眉眼柔和，轻声道谢：“谢谢你，还特意为我做这些。”
罗止正淡淡一笑，将灵匕递到她手中：“拿着吧，往后遇到危险，也能多一分自保的底气。”
李紫云握紧微凉的匕身，认真点了点头，眼底多了几分坚定。她悄悄拿起木弓与灵箭，走到空旷沙滩上练习。晨曦落在她肩头，把她的身影拉得纤细又倔强。抬手、拉弓、瞄准、松箭，一遍又一遍，哪怕手臂发酸、指尖泛白，她也不肯停下。
昨夜滩头上，罗止正带伤将她死死护在身后的画面，一遍遍在她脑海里闪过。她不想再做只会害怕、只会流泪的人，她想变强，想和他并肩，想在危险来临时，也能挡在他身前一次。
罗止正看着认真练习的女孩，动作依旧生涩，箭也射得不够稳，可那股不服输的劲儿，让他心头一暖。他缓步走到她身后。
罗止正声音放轻，耐心指点：“肩膀别晃，视线跟着箭尖走，稳住再放。”
李紫云吓了一跳，回头撞进他温柔的目光里，脸颊瞬间泛红，有些不好意思地小声说道：“我练得好差，总是不准。”
罗止正温声鼓励，伸手轻轻扶住她的手腕调整姿势：“已经很好了，只是姿势还不够稳。”
他上前一步，站在她身侧，一手轻轻覆在她握弓的手背上，另一手扶住她的手肘，缓缓带着她拉开弓弦。
罗止正低声细语，气息轻拂在她耳畔，语气认真而专业：“手肘抬高，后背挺直。拉弓时用背发力，不要只用手臂。”
两人距离极近，体温隔着衣衫隐隐传来，李紫云心跳微微加快，连呼吸都轻了几分，乖乖跟着他的动作调整。
罗止正带着她稳住瞄准，声音温和而清晰：“射箭不能只图准头，要懂射哪里，限制哪里。
比如对付灵兽，射脚，是为了限制它的移动，让它跑不掉；
射眼睛，是让它看不清，失去目标；
射胸腹部，那里灵气运转最盛，击中能重创它的灵力核心；
至于头部，那是致命一击的位置。”
他一边说，一边带着她的手，模拟着不同部位的瞄准点：“你看，现在我们射的是远处的石块，练的是准度。等熟练了，就要练战术。”
指尖松开，箭矢破空而出，虽未正中靶心，却也比之前稳了许多。
李紫云又惊又喜，眼睛瞬间亮了起来：“原来射箭还有这么多讲究！好像真的稳多了！”
罗止正松开手，眼底带着浅浅笑意，耐心补充：“对付不同的灵兽，射的位置也不同。像昨天的灵虾，它的软缝就是弱点。”
李紫云重重点头，眼中满是斗志：“嗯！我一定好好练！”
简单晨练结束，日光铺满沙滩。
罗止正从腰间取下银月水囊，拧开塞子递到她面前，语气温柔：“先喝点水，歇一歇。”
李紫云接过水囊小口饮下，清冽的水流滑过喉咙，瞬间驱散了晨练的燥热。她将水囊递回，罗止正仰头也喝了几口，才重新系回腰间。
李紫云这才抬头看向他，轻声问道：“我们接下来要去哪里？”
罗止正望向远处密林的方向，神色平静：“我们往沿海密林东边继续探索，看看能不能找到更多有助于恢复伤势的灵草。”
李紫云没有半分犹豫，轻轻点头：“好，我跟你一起。”
两人简单收拾一番，检查好木弓、长棍、灵匕与灵箭，便一同动身。
他们一路向东，穿过临海空坪，不多时便来到清涟溪湾。
溪水清澈见底，水面平静如镜，映着蓝天白云，四周草木青翠，是这座荒岛上少有的安宁之地。连日奔波、血战、逃命，两人身上早已沾满尘土与汗渍，连呼吸都带着疲惫。
罗止正走到溪边，从腰间取出银月水囊，俯身将水囊装满一囊清水，拧紧塞子后重新系回腰间。
他看着清澈溪水，忽然轻笑一声，故意逗她：“紫云，你算算，我们落到这座岛上，几天没冲过凉了？”
李紫云愣了愣，认真想了想，脸颊瞬间涨得通红，窘迫地低下头：“我……我不记得了，好像是六天吧。”
罗止正眼底笑意更浓，忍不住调侃道：“难怪刚才靠近你教射箭的时候，总觉得你身上臭臭的。”
content_en:
After a night's rest, there was only the sound of waves lapping on the white sandy beach late at night, and the fire burned into dark red embers. Li Ziyun quietly leaned on Luo Zhizheng's shoulder to take a nap, and the two figures were particularly quiet reflected by the firelight. As soon as the sky turned white, the cool sea breeze blew over the beach, and the sky gradually grew brighter.
Luo Zhizheng stood up gently, moving very gently for fear of disturbing the people around him. In the dim light of the morning light, he sat aside to handle the remains of the red-bearded krill that he had killed yesterday. He held a bone knife and carefully polished the hard red shrimp claws with a focused and serious expression.
Li Ziyun slowly opened his eyes and saw his busy figure at a glance. Curious, he walked over quietly.
Li Ziyun blinked his clear eyes and said with a bit of curiosity in his tone: "Zhizheng, what are you doing?"
Luo Zhi was looking up at her, with a gentle smile in his eyes, and raised the half-finished product in his hand: "I will make you a spiritual dagger so that you can carry it with you for self-defense. I have used up all the arrows in the battle yesterday, so I will use shrimp shells to make up ten more arrows for you."
While he was talking, he had cut the shrimp claws into a small and sharp dagger body, carefully wrapped the handle with flexible rattan, and a red-clawed spiritual dagger with restrained coldness was finally formed. The remaining shrimp shells were cut into arrowheads and equipped with wooden shafts and feathers. After a while, ten red-shell spiritual arrows were neatly placed on the rocks, with far more power than ordinary wooden arrows.
Li Ziyun looked at the exquisite spirit daggers and arrows in front of him, his heart warmed, his eyebrows softened, and he thanked softly: "Thank you, you did this specially for me."
Luo Zhizheng smiled faintly and handed the spirit dagger to her hand: "Take it, it will give you more confidence to protect yourself when encountering danger in the future."
Li Ziyun held the cold dagger tightly and nodded seriously, his eyes a little firmer. She quietly picked up the wooden bow and spiritual arrows and walked to the empty beach to practice. The morning light fell on her shoulders, making her figure slim and stubborn. She raised her hand, drew the bow, aimed, and released the arrow, over and over again, even if her arms were sore and her fingertips turned white, she would not stop.
The image of Luo Zhi protecting her behind him on the beach last night flashed over and over in her mind. She no longer wanted to be someone who could only be afraid and cry. She wanted to become stronger, to be by his side, and to stand in front of him when danger came.
Luo Zhi was looking at the girl who was practicing seriously. Her movements were still jerky and her arrows were not shooting steadily enough, but her unwillingness to admit defeat made his heart warm. He walked slowly behind her.
Luo Zhizheng lowered his voice and patiently instructed: "Don't shake your shoulders, follow the tip of the arrow with your eyes, hold it steady before releasing it."
Li Ziyun was startled, turned around and met his gentle gaze, her cheeks turned red instantly, and she whispered with some embarrassment: "I'm so bad at practice, I'm always wrong."
Luo Zhizheng encouraged her warmly, stretched out his hand to gently hold her wrist and adjust her posture: "It's already good, but the posture is not stable enough."
He took a step forward, stood beside her, placed one hand gently on the back of her hand holding the bow, and held her elbow with the other hand, slowly leading her to draw the bow string.
Luo Zhizheng was whispering, his breath caressing her ears, his tone serious and professional: "Raise your elbows and straighten your back. Use your back to draw the bow, not just your arms."
The distance between the two was extremely close, and body temperature could be heard faintly through his clothes. Li Ziyun's heartbeat accelerated slightly, and he even breathed a little lighter, obediently adjusting to his movements.
Luo Zhi was leading her to keep her aim steady, and his voice was gentle and clear: "In archery, you can't just aim for the target, you have to know where to shoot and where to limit.
For example, when dealing with a spiritual beast, shooting at its feet is to restrict its movement so that it cannot run away;
Shooting the eyes makes them unable to see clearly and lose their target;
Shoot into the chest and abdomen, where spiritual energy circulates most strongly, and hitting its spiritual core can severely damage it;
As for the head, that's where the fatal blow was. "
As he spoke, he took her hand and simulated the aiming points of different parts: "You see, now we are shooting rocks in the distance, and we are practicing accuracy. Once we are proficient, we will practice tactics."
The fingertips were released, and the arrow shot out of the air. Although it did not hit the target, it was much more stable than before.
Li Ziyun was surprised and happy, and his eyes lit up instantly: "It turns out there are so many things to pay attention to in archery! It seems to be much safer!"
Luo Zhizheng let go of his hand, with a slight smile in his eyes, and patiently added: "To deal with different spiritual beasts, the shooting positions are also different. Like yesterday's spiritual shrimp, its soft seams are its weaknesses."
Li Ziyun nodded heavily, his eyes full of fighting spirit: "Yes! I will definitely practice hard!"
After the simple morning exercise, the sun fills the beach.
Luo Zhizheng took off the silver moon water bag from his waist, unscrewed the stopper and handed it to her, with a gentle tone: "Drink some water first and take a rest."
Li Ziyun took the water bag and drank it in small sips. The refreshing water flowed down his throat, instantly dispelling the heat from the morning exercise. She handed the water bag back, and Luo Zhizheng raised his head and took a few sips before tying it back around his waist.
Li Ziyun then looked up at him and asked softly: "Where are we going next?"
Luo Zhi was looking towards the distant dense forest with a calm expression: "Let's continue exploring to the east of the coastal dense forest to see if we can find more spiritual herbs that can help recover from injuries."
Li Ziyun didn't hesitate for a moment and nodded gently: "Okay, I'll go with you."
The two simply packed up, checked the wooden bows, long sticks, spiritual daggers and spiritual arrows, and then set off together.
They went all the way east, passed through Linhaikongping, and soon arrived at Qinglianxi Bay.
The stream is crystal clear, the water surface is as calm as a mirror, reflecting the blue sky and white clouds, and is surrounded by green vegetation. It is a rare peaceful place on this deserted island. After running around, fighting bloody battles, and escaping for their lives for days, the two of them were already stained with dust and sweat, and even their breathing was tired.
Luo Zhizheng walked to the stream, took out the silver moon water bag from his waist, leaned over and filled the water bag with clean water, tightened the stopper and tied it back to his waist.
He looked at the clear stream and suddenly chuckled, deliberately teasing her: "Ziyun, do you think we landed on this island, how many days have we not had a shower?"
